paper_metadata.title: 96-GHz Static Frequency Divider in SiGe Bipolar Technology
paper_metadata.abstract: A static frequency divider designed in a 210-GHz , 0.13m SiGe bipolar technology is reported. At a 5.5-V power supply, the circuit consumes 44 mA per latch (140 mA total for the chip, with input–output stages). With single-ended sine wave clock input, the divider is operational from 7.5 to 91.6 GHz. Differential clocking under the same conditions extends the frequency range to 96.6 GHz. At 5.0 V and 100 mA total current (28 mA per latch), the divider operates from 2 to 85.2 GHz (single-ended sine wave input).
